children: Football season is back, and Applebee’s, the Official Grill + Bar Sponsor of the NFL, has one of the hottest tickets in town for fans hunting for gameday food deals. Starting today,
for the free Applebee’s NFL Season Wing Ticket, a season-long pass that unlocks six free Boneless Wings To Go every week with a $15 online purchase.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:
Whether you’re providing the gameday spread, heading to a tailgate or grabbing dinner before kickoff, Applebee’s has your weekly wing lineup covered.

Beginning September 13, Applebee’s NFL Season Wing Ticket holders will receive an email every Sunday through January 10, 2027, with a unique code to redeem six free Boneless Wings with any online To Go order of $15 or more placed through the Applebee’s website or Applebee’s mobile app. Each weekly code is valid Sunday through Thursday of the same week.

“At Applebee’s, we’re guaranteeing a win for our NFL Season Wing Ticket holders with six free Boneless Wings every week from September 13 through January 10, 2027,” said Michelle Chin, chief marketing officer at Applebee’s. “Whether watching a game at home or picking up a snack on the way to the stadium, football is better with our delicious Boneless Wings. So, sign up for your Applebee’s NFL Season Wing Ticket today to score free wings all season long!”

Applebee’s Boneless Wings are crispy breaded pieces of tender boneless chicken tossed in guests’ choice of sauce, including Classic Buffalo, Extra Hot Buffalo, Honey BBQ, Sweet Asian Chile, Garlic Parmesan and Honey Pepper. The fan-favorite dish comes complete with choice of Bleu cheese or house-made buttermilk ranch dressing.
Fans can sign up today at
and start collecting their weekly wing codes on Sunday, September 13, after the season kicks off.
To find your local restaurant, visit Applebees.com/restaurants. To order Applebee’s To Go or delivery, visit Applebees.com or the Applebee’s mobile app (iOS, Google).
For even more exclusive offers,
guests can join Club Applebee’s and become part of the neighborhood with a welcome offer!

*For a limited time at participating locations. Offer valid 8/31/26 - 1/10/27 for online orders via the Applebee’s website or mobile app only. Minimum order of $15 excluding alcohol, gift cards, tax, delivery and service fees, and gratuity. Limit one order of 6 free Boneless Wings per week. Not valid on third party delivery sites. Other restrictions may apply.

From raising money for local charities to hosting community fundraisers, Applebee’s is always Doin’ Good in the Neighborhood®.

Applebee’s and its franchise operations together consisted of 1,439 Applebee’s restaurants in the United States, two U.S. territories and 17 countries outside the United States as of June 28, 2026.
